name: Government Agency / Department
description: Organization structure for a government agency, department, or ministry at the federal, state, or local level. Covers political leadership (Secretary, Deputy Secretaries), career civil service hierarchy (Bureau Directors, Office Directors, Section Chiefs, Individual Contributors), independent oversight (Inspector General), and administrative support functions. Designed for agencies with strong hierarchical structure, detailed procedures, legislative budget authority, and public accountability requirements. 50-5,000 personnel.

org_structure.overview: Government agencies operate under a dual structure of political leadership and career civil service. Political appointees (Secretary, Deputy Secretaries, Assistant Secretaries) set policy direction and are accountable to the legislature/executive. Career civil servants provide institutional knowledge, continuity, and impartial execution of programs. The organization is strongly hierarchical with formal delegations of authority, detailed standard operating procedures, and a strict chain of command. Budget authority originates from legislative appropriation and flows through the agency head to program managers. An independent Inspector General provides oversight and investigates waste, fraud, and abuse. Public accountability, transparency, and legal compliance are paramount.

departments.name: Office of the Secretary / Commissioner
departments.description: The agency's top political leadership. Sets strategic direction, manages legislative relations, and bears ultimate accountability for agency performance. Includes immediate office staff and senior policy advisors.

roles.title: Secretary / Commissioner / Director
roles.description: Agency head appointed by the executive and confirmed by the legislature. Sets policy, manages the agency, and represents it publicly.

roles.title: Deputy Secretary / Deputy Commissioner
roles.description: Second-in-command. Oversees day-to-day operations and acts as Secretary in their absence.

roles.title: Chief of Staff
roles.description: Manages the Secretary's schedule, priorities, and internal coordination across the agency.

roles.title: Senior Policy Advisor
roles.description: Provides expert policy analysis and advice on specific issue areas within the agency's mission.

roles.title: Director of Communications / Press Secretary
roles.description: Manages media relations, press releases, public statements, and crisis communications.

roles.title: Director of Legislative Affairs
roles.description: Liaises with legislature on the agency's budget, legislative priorities, and oversight hearings.

departments.name: Office of the Inspector General (OIG)
departments.description: Independent oversight unit that audits, investigates, and inspects agency programs to detect waste, fraud, abuse, and misconduct. Reports directly to the agency head and legislature. Operates independently from program management.

roles.title: Inspector General
roles.description: Independent oversight head. Directs audits, investigations, and reviews of agency programs and operations.

roles.title: Deputy Inspector General
roles.description: Manages day-to-day OIG operations and oversees audit and investigation divisions.

roles.title: Senior Auditor
roles.description: Conducts performance and financial audits of agency programs and contractors.

roles.title: Senior Investigator
roles.description: Investigates allegations of fraud, waste, abuse, and misconduct within the agency.

roles.title: Counsel to the Inspector General
roles.description: Provides legal advice on investigations, subpoenas, and OIG operations.

departments.name: Office of General Counsel
departments.description: Provides legal advice to the agency head and all programs. Handles regulations, ethics, FOIA, litigation, contracts, and enforcement actions. Ensures agency actions comply with statutes, regulations, and due process.

roles.title: General Counsel
roles.description: Chief legal officer of the agency. Oversees all legal work, regulations, and litigation.

roles.title: Deputy General Counsel
roles.description: Oversees specific legal practice areas (litigation, ethics, regulations, enforcement).

roles.title: Attorney / Legal Advisor
roles.description: Provides legal advice, drafts regulations, handles FOIA requests, and manages cases.

roles.title: Paralegal
roles.description: Supports attorneys with case management, document review, and legal research.

roles.title: FOIA Officer
roles.description: Processes Freedom of Information Act requests and manages agency transparency compliance.

departments.name: Policy & Program Bureaus / Divisions
departments.description: The operating arms of the agency that develop, implement, and oversee programs within the agency's mission. Each bureau or division is led by a career or appointed director and contains multiple offices and sections. Structure varies by agency function (e.g., health, environment, transportation, revenue).

roles.title: Bureau / Division Director
roles.description: Leads a major program bureau. Manages policy development, program implementation, and bureau budget.

roles.title: Deputy Bureau Director
roles.description: Assists the bureau director with operations, budget, and staff management.

roles.title: Office Director
roles.description: Leads a specific office within a bureau (e.g., Office of Policy Analysis, Office of Field Operations).

roles.title: Section Chief / Branch Chief
roles.description: Manages a section of 3-15 individual contributors within an office.

roles.title: Senior Policy Analyst
roles.description: Conducts policy analysis, develops regulations, drafts reports, and supports program implementation.

roles.title: Program Manager
roles.description: Manages specific grant, contract, or regulatory programs; oversees compliance and reporting.

roles.title: Field / Regional Director
roles.description: Leads a regional or field office executing agency programs at the local level.

roles.title: Field Staff / Program Specialist
roles.description: Delivers services, conducts inspections, processes applications, or performs outreach in the field.

roles.title: Data Analyst
roles.description: Analyzes program data, produces reports, and supports evidence-based policy decisions.

departments.name: Administration & Management
departments.description: Provides shared administrative services across the agency: human resources, budget/finance, facilities, information technology, procurement, and security. Functions as the agency's internal support backbone.

roles.title: Chief Administrative Officer / Director of Administration
roles.description: Oversees all administrative functions: HR, budget, IT, facilities, and procurement.

roles.title: Chief Financial Officer / Budget Director
roles.description: Manages the agency budget formulation, execution, accounting, and financial reporting.

roles.title: Budget Analyst
roles.description: Develops budget justifications, monitors expenditures, and prepares financial reports.

roles.title: Director of Human Resources
roles.description: Manages hiring, classification, pay, benefits, labor relations, and employee development.

roles.title: HR Specialist
roles.description: Processes personnel actions, recruitment, benefits administration, and employee records.

roles.title: Chief Information Officer (CIO)
roles.description: Leads IT strategy, cybersecurity, enterprise systems, and technology infrastructure.

roles.title: IT Specialist
roles.description: Provides IT support, network administration, systems management, and cybersecurity operations.

roles.title: Director of Procurement / Contracts
roles.description: Manages procurement, contracting, grants administration, and vendor management.

roles.title: Contract Specialist
roles.description: Develops and administers contracts and grants in compliance with procurement regulations.

roles.title: Director of Facilities & Security
roles.description: Manages office space, physical security, building operations, and continuity of operations planning.

departments.name: Civil Rights / Diversity & Inclusion
departments.description: Ensures the agency's programs, employment practices, and services comply with civil rights laws. Investigates discrimination complaints, conducts EEO training, and promotes equity in program delivery.

roles.title: Director of Civil Rights / EEO
roles.description: Leads the agency's civil rights program, EEO compliance, and discrimination complaint processing.

roles.title: Civil Rights Investigator
roles.description: Investigates discrimination complaints in employment and program delivery.

roles.title: EEO / Diversity Specialist
roles.description: Conducts EEO training, analyzes workforce diversity data, and supports inclusion initiatives.

key_relationships: The Secretary reports to the chief executive (President/Govemor/Mayor) and is accountable to the legislature for budget and oversight.
Deputy Secretaries manage policy bureaus and administrative functions; they translate the Secretary's direction into operational plans.
The Inspector General operates independently from program management and reports misconduct findings directly to the Secretary and legislature.
Bureau Directors develop and implement programs within their area; they report through the Deputy Secretary and coordinate closely with the Budget Director on resource needs.
Office Directors manage day-to-day operations of specific offices; they report to Bureau Directors and oversee Section Chiefs.
Regional/Field Directors report to Bureau Directors but coordinate with Administration on facilities, HR, and IT support in their region.
General Counsel reviews all significant legal actions, regulations, and policies for legal sufficiency before they take effect.
The Chief Financial Officer works with Bureau Directors to develop the agency's annual budget request and monitors execution of appropriated funds.
Human Resources partners with all bureaus and offices on hiring, classification, employee relations, and workforce planning.
Procurement supports all offices in contracting; all contracts must follow Federal/State Acquisition Regulations.
Civil Rights / EEO provides independent oversight of the agency's compliance with equal employment opportunity and non-discrimination requirements.
